INSERT INTO employer_candidates (name, norm_name, regions, sources, website)
SELECT c.name, c.norm_name, c.regions, c.sources, c.website
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
  AS c(name text, norm_name text, regions text[], sources text[], website text)
WHERE c.norm_name IS NOT NULL AND c.norm_name <> ''
ON CONFLICT (norm_name) DO UPDATE SET
  website = COALESCE(employer_candidates.website, EXCLUDED.website),
  regions = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(employer_candidates.regions || EXCLUDED.regions)),
  sources = ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(employer_candidates.sources || EXCLUDED.sources));

(SELECT id, name, regions, website FROM employer_candidates
  WHERE NOT ('osm' = ANY(sources))
    AND (status = 'new' OR (status = 'not_found' AND attempts < $2::int
         AND checked_at < now() - make_interval(days => $3::int)))
  ORDER BY ads ASC, last_seen DESC LIMIT $1::int)
UNION ALL
(SELECT id, name, regions, website FROM employer_candidates
  WHERE 'osm' = ANY(sources)
    AND (status = 'new' OR (status = 'not_found' AND attempts < $2::int
         AND checked_at < now() - make_interval(days => $3::int)))
  ORDER BY random() LIMIT $4::int);

WITH r AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
    AS r(id bigint, name text, status text, ats text, token text, regions text[], note text)
), upd AS (
  UPDATE employer_candidates c
     SET status = r.status, attempts = c.attempts + 1, checked_at = now(), note = r.note
    FROM r WHERE c.id = r.id
  RETURNING c.id
)
INSERT INTO employers (name, ats, token, regions, source)
SELECT r.name, r.ats, r.token, r.regions, 'discovered' FROM r
 WHERE r.status = 'found' AND r.ats IS NOT NULL AND r.token IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(r.regions) > 0
ON CONFLICT (ats, token) DO NOTHING
RETURNING name, ats, token;
